ref_text: So I'm building an app that turns them into an actual plan. Copy a TikTok link, open Trip and it asks, add this TikTok. It reads the caption and pulls out the place it names.

lines.name: The hook
lines.text: You've saved forty TikToks for this trip. And on the trip, you'll open none of them.

lines.name: The explainer
lines.text: Tap Smart Add, and it picks the day and time that fits, with the least extra travel.
